Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server.image

Record Class OmeroPixels

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server.image.OmeroPixels
Record Components:
type - a link to the specifications of this object (TYPE is expected). Optional
sizeX - the width of the image. Required
sizeY - the height of the image. Required
sizeZ - the number of z-stacks of the image. Required
sizeC - the number of channels of the image. Required
sizeT - the number of time points of the image. Required
physicalSizeX - the size of pixels on the x-axis. Optional
physicalSizeY - the size of pixels on the y-axis. Optional
physicalSizeZ - the size of pixels on the z-axis. Optional
imageType - the data type of the pixels. Required
public record OmeroPixels(String type, Integer sizeX, Integer sizeY, Integer sizeZ, Integer sizeC, Integer sizeT, OmeroPhysicalSize physicalSizeX, OmeroPhysicalSize physicalSizeY, OmeroPhysicalSize physicalSizeZ, OmeroImageType imageType) extends Record
An OMERO screen as described by the OME specifications.

A RuntimeException is thrown if one required parameter is null.
